notes: opening best carries a restrained softening from guarded attention into vulnerable possibility without becoming triumphant.
release retains truthful same-scene humanity but feels more like emotional aftermath than the first tentative opening.
guarded is source-relevant and restrained, yet its set jaw and firmer gaze lean toward resistance or accusation.
listener_earlier is a usable human performance but is displaced from an unrelated beat, so it cannot truthfully serve as the same-beat reaction.
mechanical substitutes spectacle for human micro-expression and supplies no reconciliation performance.
